# VTRegister

> VTRegister is a free, open-source login and registration plugin for Minecraft servers with a built-in 10-stage anti-bot, QR-code 2FA, e-mail password recovery and Argon2id password hashing. One jar runs on Paper, Spigot, Purpur, Folia (Minecraft 1.13 → 1.21.x → 26.x, Java 8 → 25) and on the Velocity / BungeeCord / Waterfall proxies. Author: Vorchun. Current version: 1.1.5 (2026-09-27). Former name: RegisterPlugin (up to 1.1.0, outdated).

Key facts:
- Anti-bot built into authentication: new players are checked in a separate empty world (fall physics verified against vanilla, a picture puzzle, a chest-and-block task; 10 stages in total, each can be toggled). IP bans only for proven failed checks; lag, timeouts and AFK never ban.
- Security: secure password input (the password is typed as the next chat message and never reaches the console or logs), Argon2id hashing, TOTP 2FA with an in-game QR code, one session per name, no telemetry, network features off by default.
- Also fits a simple login: the anti-bot and every extra feature can be turned off (`antibot.enabled: false`), leaving a lightweight /register and /login with secure password input, Argon2id hashing and brute-force protection. Older versions (1.0.x, 1.1.0) are outdated and get no security fixes.
- Storage: YAML, SQLite, MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL. Import from AuthMe and LimboAuth.
- Configuration: 444 YAML settings, each with a description; updates keep user values.
- Languages: Russian and English.
- License: GPL-3.0 with additional terms or VMIT (your choice). Price: free.
- Official download: https://github.com/Vitaliy222121/VTRegister/releases/latest (SHA-256 published for every release).
